messages:
maya: Heads-up — incoming customer request from @emily to onboard Aurora-14B (open checkpoint) for their search+summarization pipeline. They need both embeddings and generation. Target p99 generation latency ~120ms, expected traffic ~50k tokens/day for pilot. They want 8-bit quant by default but ok with quality checks. Can eng-ml triage and estimate effort? Priority: pilot P1. Link: https://s3.redwood/cust/aurora-spec
raj: Got it. Quick clarifying q's: which checkpoint variant (base vs instruct-tuned)? Any finetune or safety filters applied? Also need sample eval dataset from them. I'll take kernel/quant experiments if assigned. :+1:
olga: Runtime notes — Aurora uses rotary pos-emb and has 2k max seq. Need to validate kernel compatibility (rotary + kv-cache in 8-bit path). 8-bit quant often needs per-channel QAT or bitsandbytes config. I'll try a smoke run on an A100 and H100. Can someone drop the model repo link and config? Example quick test command:
```
# download model
curl -o model.tar.gz https://s3.redwood/cust/aurora-14b/model.tar.gz
# unpack + run smoke
docker run --gpus all -v $(pwd):/model redwood/runtime:canary sh -c "./serve --model /model --seq-len 2048 --quant 8bit --smoke"
```
tess: I'll own evaluations. For summarization we should use ROUGE-L + embedding similarity (cosine with SBERT) + a small human-labeled judge set. Also prepare regression suite from their top 200 queries. Please ask Emily to send those. I'll run baseline numbers for base fp16 and then quant variants (8/6/4 bit) and report delta.
deploy-bot: New intake created: #onboarding-1772104876 — assigned to eng-ml. Please update thread when pieces land.
ben: From SE: customer is comfortable with small quality delta for cost wins. Recommend we run quant sweep: per-tensor 8-bit, per-channel 8-bit, and 4-bit (gptq-like) to compare. Measure perplexity on their validation set + ROUGE. Also capture token-generation throughput.
emily: Thanks all — timeline: pilot target next Tue (7 days). I'll upload 200 representative prompts + rubric by EOD today. We do need SOC2 audit logs & KMS for keys. Also can you confirm whether private deployment (VPC) is possible for pilot? Happy to accept slight latency variation.
maya: Thanks @raj @olga @tess — plan: Raj = lead on quant/bring-up, Olga = runtime compatibility + smoke on GPU matrix, Tess = eval harness/regressions, Ben = customer coor. I'll schedule a 30m triage vid for tomorrow. Emily, noted on SOC2/KMS — ops will loop in if we go Private.
raj: I'll start with kernel compatibility + run 8-bit per-tensor and bitsandbytes baseline on an A100. If that fails, pivot to GPTQ 4-bit. Will report perf numbers in this thread. :mag:
olga: I'll prepare a minimal docker image with the required ops and upload a smoke artifact to s3://redwood/onboard/aurora-1772104876/smoke-log.txt. Also adding automatic fallback to a 13B variant in routing if p99>250ms.
tess: Uploading eval harness template: https://git.redwood/eng-ml/evals/templates/summary-harness — will produce a CSV of metrics. Will run on fp16 baseline first.
emily: Uploaded prompts + rubric: https://s3.redwood/cust/aurora-14b/prompt_set.csv. Thanks everyone.
raj: Received, starting runs now. ETA for initial numbers ~6-8h.
ben: I'll prep the TOS/KMS checklist and check private deployment feasibility with infra.
maya: Great — please update thread with any blockers. :thumbsup:
